status.description: Ticket lifecycle status. Only 'open' tickets are eligible for SLA breach checks.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the ticket was created. Start of the SLA clock.

first_response_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the first agent response, or null if none has been sent yet.

escalated.description: True once this ticket has been escalated for missing the first-response SLA.

escalated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when escalation happened, or null if not escalated.
